points.text: Kanohar Electricals targets ~₹950 Cr FY27 revenue; order book at ₹2,026 Cr
Kanohar is expanding 400 kV transformer output and adding 18,000 MVA brownfield capacity for FY29, backed by an expanding order backlog.
Management guided for approximately **₹950 Cr** revenue in FY27 with an EBITDA margin profile broadly similar to FY26.
points.quote: We are targeting a revenue of approximately INR950 crores with a broadly similar EBITDA margin profile as FY26.

points.text: The consolidated order book stood at **₹2,026 Cr** as of June 30, 2026, with an incremental **₹867.3 Cr** orders added in Q2.
points.quote: As of June 30, 2026, our consolidated order book stood at INR2,026 odd crores, up 11% from INR1,818.3 crores as of March 31, 2026.

points.text: Planning an **18,000 MVA** brownfield expansion at Gangol to come online for FY29, funded partly through IPO proceeds.
points.quote: On the capacity side, we are planning a brownfield expansion of about 18,000 MVA at our Gangol plant.

points.text: The ₹2,026 Cr order book equals 25.0% of market cap and provides visibility across the 18 to 24 month execution cycle into FY29.
points.quote: The order book is expected to be executed over the next 18 to 24 months.

points.text: High-voltage 400 kV transformers rose to 70.16% of revenue in Q1FY27, up from 52% in FY26, enriching product mix.
points.quote: The contribution of 400 kV Transformers increased from 10.3% in FY24 to 52% in FY26 and stood at about 70% in Q1 of FY27.

points.text: Railways present a ₹20,000 Cr market opportunity for traction transformers over 5 to 10 years, where Kanohar is one of two certified vendors.
points.quote: And just to give a ballpark number, that that will translate into roughly INR20,000 crores of market opportunity for just for just the traction transformers in the next 5 to 10 years.

points.text: Targeting approximately ₹950 Cr revenue in FY27 with EBITDA margins broadly similar to FY26.
points.quote: We are targeting a revenue of approximately INR950 crores with a broadly similar EBITDA margin profile as FY26.

points.text: Railways envisage 1,000 traction substations requiring ~2,000 Scott transformers worth ~₹20,000 Cr over 5-10 years.
points.quote: And just to give a ballpark number, that that will translate into roughly INR20,000 crores of market opportunity for just for just the traction transformers in the next 5 to 10 years.

points.text: Working capital cycle stands at roughly 120 days, comprised of 120 receivable days and 80 inventory days.
points.quote: On working capital, our business carries roughly 120 days of receivables and 80 days of inventory, offset by 70 to 80 days of payables.

points.text: Supply chain planning is viewed as the primary operational risk to maintaining execution timelines.
points.quote: In terms of risk, if you were to think about it, supply chain would be the key risk at this point.

points.text: Tips Music Q2 revenue rose 35% YoY to ₹120 Cr; full-year content cost guided at ₹90-100 Cr
Tips Music posted 35% YoY revenue growth in Q2 FY27 and maintained its full-year content spend cap at ₹90-100 Cr despite ₹71 Cr incurred in H1.
Q2 FY27 **revenue** rose 35% YoY to **₹120 Cr**, while **operating EBITDA** grew 25% YoY to **₹84.64 Cr** with a 70.5% margin.
points.quote: Revenue for Q2 FY '27 stood at INR120 crores as compared to INR89.2 crores in Q2 FY '26, representing a year-on-year growth of 35%.

points.text: Q2 FY27 **PAT** increased 23% YoY to **₹65.5 Cr**; H1 FY27 revenue reached **₹227 Cr** (+28% YoY) with PAT of **₹109 Cr** (+11% YoY).
points.quote: Profit after tax stood at INR65.5 crores, representing a growth of 23% over the previous year quarter, while PAT margin for the quarter was 54%.

points.text: The company completed an open-market **buyback** of **₹44.44 Cr** and the board declared an **interim dividend** of **₹6.50 per share**.
points.quote: We have successfully completed the buyback of shares amounting to INR44.44 crores through open market buyback.

points.text: H1 FY27 content cost reached ₹71 Cr of the ₹90-100 Cr full-year guidance, meaning H2 will be substantially lighter on content investments.
points.quote: Please note, during the 6 months, the content cost was at INR71 crores, which is front-loaded, and we expect the content cost for the full year to be in the range of INR90 crores to INR100 crores only.

points.text: Management expects to exceed its baseline 20% annual top-line and bottom-line growth guidance, supported by festive seasonality in H2.
points.quote: We would exceed our 20% guidance.

points.text: Management expects to exceed 20% annual revenue and profit growth guidance, keeping conservative guidance publicly.
points.quote: We would exceed our 20% guidance. We don't want to put a specific number to it.

points.text: YouTube Shorts monetisation deal remains under negotiation and is expected to be completed in Q3 FY27.
points.quote: On the question of YouTube Shorts, the deal is still under negotiation. It's not been concluded.

points.text: Catalog content acquired three or more years ago contributes around 85% of company revenue, with recent content providing 15%.
points.quote: Around 85% of our revenue comes from releases which are three years and before, and 15% comes from releases in over the what we have acquired content over the last three years.
